newsitem.title: GERMANY: Varta says U.S. joint venture to be ended.
newsitem.headline: Varta says U.S. joint venture to be ended.

text.p: German battery maker Varta AG said it had agreed with its joint venture partners Duracell und Toshiba that their joint venture in the United States would be closed at the year-end.
The company said in a statement that the reason for the closure of the one-year-old plant lay in high competition in the area of rechargeable battery systems.
Production at Toshiba's plant in Takasi in Japan would be markedly cheaper, it said.
Varta said the transfer of production there would be more favourable for all three companies, which together have formed an alliance known as L.L.P. This alliance would continue.
The plant to be closed employs 152 workers.
